text:
Ivy: hi all, first week question  I can reach the bastion but my local docker build that pulls base images from internal-proxy.corp:8080 fails unless I curl the proxy from the bastion. Seems like the corp VPN isn't routing that host to the tunnel. anyone know onboarding quirks?
Carlos: welcome Ivy! what OS and VPN client? sometimes the split-tunnel profile only sends HTTP proxy routes for full-time employees.
Ivy: Fedora 38, using our WireGuard wrapper. `docker build` errors look like `dial tcp: lookup internal-proxy.corp: no such host`
Meera: likely DNS for internal domains isn't pushed to your client. Can you `dig internal-proxy.corp +short` locally and on bastion?
Ivy: local `dig` returns nothing. on bastion `dig internal-proxy.corp +short` returns 10.42.5.10
Carlos: yup - missing DNS. Two quick unblocks: 1) set up an SSH tunnel and point docker daemon at localhost proxy, or 2) add an /etc/hosts entry if the IP is stable. Which preferred?
Ivy: i don't want to mess with hosts. How do i point docker at a local proxy?
Meera: run `ssh -L 8081:internal-proxy.corp:8080 ubuntu@bastion.company` then in another terminal `export HTTP_PROXY=http://localhost:8081` and run your `docker build`. Docker uses env vars for the buildkit client.
Ivy: tried that and build started pulling layers over the tunnel. good workaround. thanks.
Carlos: i'll raise a ticket to include the internal proxy domain and the VPC CIDR in the onboarding split-tunnel profile; security will need to review resolver exposure for onboarding devices. infra-bot?
infra-bot: Created INFRA-5610: "onboarding: include internal-proxy.corp DNS + VPC CIDRs in WireGuard profile for new hires" assigned to @Carlos. SLA: 72h.
Ivy: also noticed that when my laptop goes to sleep the vpn reconnect sometimes loses the pushed routes and i have to reconnect twice. anyone else hit that?
Meera: yes, OS-level sleep/roaming can cause the client to restart and miss the quick route push. We'll add a note in the ticket to test route persistence on macOS/Linux/Windows.
Carlos: additional option for security: rather than opening the resolver to new hires, we can run a bastion-side HTTP proxy and give short-lived creds to new hire sessions. i'll propose both in INFRA-5610.
Ivy: appreciate it 60a unblocked for now. i'll leave a comment in the ticket with my laptop model if that helps debugging.
Meera: welcome to the team, Ivy! ping here if INFRA-5610 doesn't move in 3 days.
